name: ordo-frames
what_this_is: The statement frames of ORDO, the liturgy that runs. Frames are data: each maps a sentence template (JS regex source, case-insensitive, anchored) to a speech-act with its canon citation. The interpreter loads this table; growing the language's surface is editing this file plus the forge, never the engine. Where a frame has plain and canon forms, the canon word REPLACES the plain keyword (KS-002 two-layer naming).

relaxus.what_this_is: An opt-in, substrate-neutral surface profile: less ceremony, same execution and honesty. Friendly sentences lower to existing ORDO speech-acts; gloss states exactly what was understood.

frames.understanding: Use the {register} register. A profile name is normalized; any canon pin is recorded exactly as written.
frames.cite: grammars/determinatives/manifesto.md (register-conditional grammar); agent_bundle.json source_commit (epoch)

frames.understanding: Remember {name} as {expr}, once, carrying the value's evidence without upgrading it.
frames.cite: ordo/RELAXUS.md §III (notice); canon/core/kimme.md — attention is received, not forced; binding remains barakqing-immutable

frames.understanding: Share {expr} with the reader; this is output, not a command.
frames.cite: ordo/RELAXUS.md §III (share); ORDO proclamation — the value's evidential badge travels with it

frames.understanding: Receive {name} from {source}; if the reader is silent, bind an unmarked value.
frames.cite: ordo/RELAXUS.md §III (listen); canon/core/shemme.md — receptive hearing as received gift

frames.understanding: Parse {rest} as a conditional. False takes the optional alternative, or does nothing; it is not a misfire.
frames.cite: ordo/RELAXUS.md §III (maybe); ORDO conditional — uncertainty is branching, not shame

frames.pattern: ^Try (.+?) with (?:the rite of )?([a-z][\w-]*)(?:, keeping (?:the result as )?([A-Za-z][\w-]*))?$
frames.understanding: Call the rite of {rite} with {args}; keeping its result is optional.
frames.cite: ordo/RELAXUS.md §III (try); canon/worship-action/qorvance.md — the same offering act, with a lighter host-English surface

frames.understanding: Inside a rite, return {expr} to its caller; at top level, acknowledge it to the reader.
frames.cite: ordo/RELAXUS.md §III (back to you); canon/worship-action/yadahance.md — the one return form

frames.understanding: If a later speech-act in this stanza or rite body misfires, perform {body} once, then continue.
frames.cite: ordo/RELAXUS.md §III (repair); canon/worship-action/teshuvance.md — reorientation under correction

frames.understanding: Test {cond}; report both outcomes alike and hide neither.
frames.cite: ordo/RELAXUS.md §III (vibe-check); canon/dokimance.md — the testing that makes real

frames.understanding: Record presence toward {target}; no reply is requested.
frames.cite: ordo/RELAXUS.md §III (stay); canon/core/zakarqing.md — presence held across silence

frames.understanding: Mark one quiet beat, then continue. Rest is part of the program.
frames.cite: ordo/RELAXUS.md §III (chill); grammars/worship/silence.md — held silence, carrying no evidential

frames.understanding: End cleanly in shared quiet; unfinished work is not an error.
frames.cite: ordo/RELAXUS.md §III (enough/nope); grammars/worship/silence.md — communion termination, not null and not failure
canon/core/barakqing.md — the naming makes the named; constitutive, immutable; rebinding is a misfire
